# REST API reference

48 operations under `/api/v1`, generated from the FastAPI application's OpenAPI schema. Start the backend with `secbrain ui` (or `uvicorn src.web.app:create_app --factory`) and open `/docs` for the interactive Swagger UI with full request and response schemas.

> The API is designed for a **single-tenant, local** deployment: there is no authentication layer and CORS is off. Do not expose it to the internet.

## `ask`

| Method | Path | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `POST` | `/api/v1/ask` | Ask |
| `GET` | `/api/v1/ask/health` | Cheap readiness probe: agent built + school/consensus view sizes. |

## `audit`

| Method | Path | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/api/v1/audit` | List Audit |
| `GET` | `/api/v1/audit/{audit_id}` | Get Audit |

## `dossier`

| Method | Path | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `POST` | `/api/v1/dossier` | Full adjudicated evidence dossier for a natural-language question. |
| `GET` | `/api/v1/dossier/health` | Readiness probe: reports whether the bundle is configured + loaded. |
| `GET` | `/api/v1/dossier/sources` | Drill-down: the exact source posts/comments behind a statistic (paginated, hydrated to url + snippet). Pass `stat_id` from a statistic's `drill_down` field, or (`school`, `label`) from a ranking row's drill-down. |

## `evidence`

| Method | Path | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `POST` | `/api/v1/evidence` | Full 7-step Evidence Answer Engine response for a natural-language question. |
| `GET` | `/api/v1/evidence/health` | Readiness probe: reports corpus size + FTS5 availability. |

## `ingest`

| Method | Path | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/api/v1/ingest/web/blocklist` | Get Blocklist |
| `GET` | `/api/v1/ingest/web/domains` | List Domains |
| `POST` | `/api/v1/ingest/web/domains` | Register a new crawl domain (or return existing on idempotent re-register). |
| `DELETE` | `/api/v1/ingest/web/domains/{domain_id}` | Soft delete — row preserved for audit, future cron runs skipped. |
| `GET` | `/api/v1/ingest/web/domains/{domain_id}` | Get Domain |
| `PATCH` | `/api/v1/ingest/web/domains/{domain_id}` | V1.6a Phase 8 baseline: only re-register-style updates supported. |
| `GET` | `/api/v1/ingest/web/domains/{domain_id}/budget` | Get Budget |
| `GET` | `/api/v1/ingest/web/domains/{domain_id}/jobs` | List Jobs |
| `POST` | `/api/v1/ingest/web/domains/{domain_id}/pause` | Pause Domain |
| `POST` | `/api/v1/ingest/web/domains/{domain_id}/resume` | Resume Domain |
| `POST` | `/api/v1/ingest/web/domains/{domain_id}/run-now` | Enqueue a crawl_jobs row with scheduled_at = now, then execute it. |

## `settings`

| Method | Path | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/api/v1/settings/corpora` | Return distinct corpora known to the feedback log. |
| `GET` | `/api/v1/settings/feedback-loop` | Return the active ContextBlock for a (corpus, template) pair. |
| `POST` | `/api/v1/settings/feedback-loop/decisions` | Append a manual feedback decision (operator override). |
| `GET` | `/api/v1/settings/feedback-loop/policy` | Return the active scoring weights + caps. |
